The primary operational bottleneck identified in AutoBuild's workflow is the excessive travel time required for workers to retrieve tools and materials from a centralized repository. This inefficiency stems from the significant distances across the work site, leading to lost productivity as employees spend valuable time commuting between the storage area and various construction zones. To improve efficiency, the company should consider decentralizing tool and material storage by establishing smaller, localized supply points closer to active construction areas, thereby reducing transit time and minimizing downtime.
